annotations.title: Hazards for one of my chemicals

description: Return the hazards printed in Section 2 of the SDS on file for a product in your own SDSentry inventory: signal word, hazard statements (H-code and wording), GHS pictograms (only when confirmed from the sheet) and precautionary statement codes, with a link to the sheet. When Section 2 cannot be read, the answer says to see SDS Section 2. Needs a personal SDSentry access token (created by the account owner in SDSentry, Admin, AI assistants) and an account on a free trial or a paid plan. Read-only; reads only that account's data.

product.description: Product name as it appears in your SDSentry inventory, e.g. "Acetone".
